title: Dr. Ramesh v. AIIMS
text: The petitioner, Dr. Ramesh, filed a writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution challenging his compulsory retirement from AIIMS. The petitioner alleged that the retirement was motivated by malice and that the Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) on which it was based were tampered with. The court issues a writ of mandamus to AIIMS to produce original ACRs. Examination of the ACRs reveals unexplained alterations. Natural justice requires that an employee be given an opportunity to respond to adverse ACR entries. The fundamental right to continue in public employment cannot be curtailed by a tainted process. The court quashes the compulsory retirement order. Dr. Ramesh is to be reinstated with all consequential benefits. The court also directs that his ACRs be expunged of the adverse entries, which were made in violation of the established procedure.
